text: Bench pressing for months, but you only feel it in your shoulders?
Elbows flared out wide? Your shoulders take over, and they're at risk.
Elbows glued to your sides? Now your triceps do most of the work.
Tuck them to about forty-five degrees and pinch your shoulder blades. Your chest does the pushing, and you lift more.
Try it next chest day. Save this.
